steps.title: Prepare 1% BSA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg BSA in PBS and bring the final volume to 1 mL to obtain a 1 % (w/v) BSA solution.

steps.title: Prepare MACS buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 9.96 mL 1× PBS, 100 mg (10 mg/mL) BSA, and 40 µL 0.5 M EDTA (final 2 mM) to a total volume of 10 mL (1× MACS buffer).

steps.title: Prepare Lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL RNase inhibitor (0.2 U/µL) to 3.96 mL Nuclei extraction buffer; bring to a total volume of 4 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei separation buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 80 µL RNase inhibitor (0.2 U/µL, optional for RNA‑seq), 320 µL 1 % BSA (0.04 % final), 1.12 mL Nuclei extraction buffer (14 %), and 6.56 mL PBS (or 6.48 mL if using the * formulation) to a final volume of 8 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Resuspension buffer
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL RNase inhibitor (0.2 U/µL) and 1.5 µL 1 % BSA (0.1 % final) to 1.48 mL PBS; bring to a total volume of 1.5 mL.

steps.title: Pre‑cool reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Place Puregene RBC lysis solution on ice, set centrifuge to 4 °C, and pre‑heat a water bath to 37 °C. Keep all samples and reagents cold throughout the protocol.

steps.title: Thaw frozen blood clot
steps.instruction: Incubate the frozen blood clot at 37 °C for 3 min, then transfer the tube to ice.

steps.title: Clean tube rim
steps.instruction: Wipe the outside rim of the serum‑separating tube with Kimwipes soaked in 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Invert and centrifuge clot
steps.instruction: Place the serum‑separating tube upside‑down inside a 50 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 2,000 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer clot to C tube
steps.instruction: Move the loosened clot into a gentleMACS C tube.

steps.title: Rinse tube with RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL ice‑cold RBC lysis solution to the 50 mL conical tube, rinse to recover residual sample, and transfer all liquid into the C tube. Close the C tube tightly.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Run the Multi_A_01 Miltenyi program on the gentleMACS Octo Dissociator.

steps.title: Vortex and nutate
steps.instruction: Vortex the C tube vigorously for 3 s, then place it on a nutator at 4 °C for 5 min (10 min if using fresh clot).

steps.title: Collect lysis supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette the lysis solution out of the C tube into a new 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Rinse C tube with lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL lysis buffer to the C tube, mix, and transfer the rinse to the same 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: First leukocyte spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2,000 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C, then carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the reddish leukocyte pellet.

steps.title: Second RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL RBC lysis solution to the pellet, vortex 3 s, and nutate at 4 °C for 5 min (10 min for fresh clot).

steps.title: Second leukocyte spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 2,000 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Optional cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Add an appropriate volume of 90 % fetal bovine serum + 10 % DMSO to the leukocyte pellet, aliquot into cryovials, and freeze for future use.

steps.title: Proceed to downstream path
steps.instruction: If flow sorting is required, continue to step B. If nuclei extraction is desired, continue to step C. Otherwise stop here.

steps.title: Make fresh MACS buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare MACS buffer as described in Recipe 2; make 10 mL per sorted population (e.g., 10 mL for B‑cell and 10 mL for T‑cell sorts).

steps.title: Resuspend leukocytes in MACS buffer
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL MACS buffer to the leukocyte pellet and gently pipette up/down three times.

steps.title: Filter through 70 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm MACS SmartStrainer on a 5 mL conical tube, prime with 500 µL MACS buffer, filter the cell suspension, then rinse the strainer with an additional 500 µL MACS buffer (final volume ≈3 mL).

steps.title: Set aside unstained control
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the filtered cell suspension to a microcentrifuge tube for use as an unstained control.

steps.title: Pellet cells for staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 rcf for 5 min, discard supernatant, add 100 µL MACS buffer, flick five times to resuspend.

steps.title: Add antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of each fluorochrome‑conjugated antibody (final 1:100 dilution), flick five times, and incubate at 4 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare compensation controls
steps.instruction: During the antibody incubation, for each antibody add one drop of compensation beads and 1 µL of the same antibody to separate microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL MACS buffer to the stained cells, centrifuge at 300 rcf for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 1 mL MACS buffer.

steps.title: Filter through 30 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Place a 30 µm MACS SmartStrainer on a 5 mL Polypropylene round‑bottom tube, prime with 500 µL MACS buffer, filter the cell suspension, then rinse the strainer with 500 µL MACS buffer (final volume ≈2 mL). Adjust volume if needed for the sorter.

steps.title: Proceed to flow sorting
steps.instruction: Load the filtered, stained cell suspension onto the chosen flow sorter (e.g., Sony MA900 or Miltenyi MACSQuant Tyto) and sort the desired populations.

steps.title: Add ice‑cold lysis buffer to cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer to the cell pellet (or to flow‑sorted cells), then transfer the suspension to a gentleMACS C tube.

steps.title: Rinse residual cells
steps.instruction: Rinse the original conical tube with an additional 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer and add this rinse to the same C tube.

steps.title: Close C tube and cool
steps.instruction: Close the C tube tightly beyond the first resistance, place it on the gentleMACS dissociator, and surround the samples with Octocoolers.

steps.title: Run nuclei lysis program
steps.instruction: Execute the gentleMACS program 4C_Nuclei_1 (run twice if using fresh samples).

steps.title: Ice incubation post‑lysis
steps.instruction: Immediately place the C tube on ice and incubate for 5 min (10 min for fresh samples). If flow cytometry was performed, skip directly to step D after this incubation.

steps.title: Filter nuclei through 70 µm strainer
steps.instruction: While incubating, attach a 70 µm MACS SmartStrainer to a 15 mL conical tube, prime with 500 µL lysis buffer, then pass the nuclei suspension through the strainer into the tube. Wash the strainer with 2 mL lysis buffer and discard the strainer.

steps.title: First nuclei spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei suspension at 300 rcf for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 30 µm strainer
steps.instruction: During centrifugation, attach a 30 µm MACS SmartStrainer to a 5 mL conical tube and prime with 500 µL resuspension buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend and filter nuclei
steps.instruction: Aspirate all supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL resuspension buffer by pipetting up/down gently ten times, then pass the suspension through the 30 µm strainer into the 5 mL conical tube. Rinse the strainer with an additional 500 µL resuspension buffer.

steps.title: Second nuclei spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei suspension at 300 rcf for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in nuclei separation buffer
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant completely and resuspend the nucleus pellet in 450 µL nuclei separation buffer (use 5× volume if the entire blood clot was processed).

steps.title: Add anti‑nucleus MicroBeads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL anti‑nucleus MicroBeads (5× volume if whole clot used), mix gently by pipetting, and incubate for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare LS column
steps.instruction: During the incubation, calibrate LS columns, mount the QuadroMACS Separator Unit on the MACS Multistand, and place an LS column onto the separator.

steps.title: Column equilibration
steps.instruction: Rinse the LS column with 3 mL nuclei separation buffer, allow the buffer to drip through, and discard the flowthrough.

steps.title: Apply nuclei to column
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL nuclei separation buffer to the nucleus suspension from step D5, then apply the mixture to the LS column (center of the reservoir) and discard the flowthrough.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: After the column stops dripping, wash it twice with 1 mL nuclei separation buffer, discarding the flowthrough each time and ensuring the inner column wall is rinsed.

steps.title: Elute labeled nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove the column, place it into a 5 mL conical tube, add 500 µL nuclei separation buffer onto the column, and firmly push the plunger to flush out the magnetically labeled nuclei.

steps.title: Count and assess nuclei
steps.instruction: Count the eluted nuclei (e.g., with a hemocytometer or automated counter) and visualize morphology under a microscope before downstream assays.
